components.name: Signal Button
components.description: The one action a view exists for: Start / Continue Day N, Mark complete, the quiz's go button. One per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3, 12px); height: 52px; padding: 0 4.5px 0 24px; border: 1.5px solid var(--signal, #FF4A1C); border-radius: 0; font: 700 11px/14px Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 12px), calc(100% - 12px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-signal { background: var(--signal, #FF4A1C); color: var(--on-signal, #050D10); } .ds-btn-signal .ds-end { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; background: var(--on-signal, #050D10); color: var(--signal, #FF4A1C); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 7px), calc(100% - 7px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-btn-signal:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--signal, #FF4A1C) 88%, var(--on-signal, #050D10)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--on-signal, #050D10); outline-offset: -5px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.985); }

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Every other action: Back, Overview, Search, Settings, timer actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #EAF1F2); border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #EAF1F2); border-radius: 0; font: 700 11px/14px Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 12px), calc(100% - 12px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-line:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #EAF1F2) 9%, transparent); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #FF4A1C); outline-offset: -5px; } .ds-btn-line:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.985); }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Status words and the place marks inside running text.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; padding: 0 14px 0 10px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #EAF1F2); color: var(--ink, #EAF1F2); font: 700 11px/14px Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 7px), calc(100% - 7px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-tag-quiet { border-color: var(--off, #34454B); color: var(--ink-2, #9BB5BC); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Datum field: square, ink-2 outline, filled corner triangle.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 280px; height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink-2, #9BB5BC); border-radius: 0; --corner: var(--ink-2, #9BB5BC); background: linear-gradient(to top left, var(--corner) 50%, transparent calc(50% + .5px)) 100% 100% / 9px 9px no-repeat, var(--sheet, #0B1518); color: var(--ink, #EAF1F2); font: 400 16px Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-2, #9BB5BC); } .ds-input:hover, .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--ink, #EAF1F2); --corner: var(--ink, #EAF1F2); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #EAF1F2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Block
components.description: Datum's nav block: the mark, the code, the views as tabs on a mist rail.
components.html: SAA-C03OverviewDay 03
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 52px; padding: 6px 12px; background: var(--sheet, #0B1518); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04); } .ds-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; background: var(--ink, #EAF1F2); color: var(--on-ink, #050D10); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 7px), calc(100% - 7px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-code { font: 400 11px/14px 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--ink-2, #9BB5BC); } .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; background: var(--mist, #131F23); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 12px), calc(100% - 12px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-tabs a { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; color: var(--ink-2, #9BB5BC); font: 700 11px/14px Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-tabs a:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #EAF1F2) 9%, transparent); color: var(--ink, #EAF1F2); } .ds-tabs a[aria-current] { background: var(--ink, #EAF1F2); color: var(--on-ink, #050D10); } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #FF4A1C); outline-offset: -5px; }

components.name: Plate Header

components.css: .ds-plate { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 16px; padding: 24px 24px 12px; background: var(--sheet, #0B1518); color: var(--ink, #EAF1F2); } .ds-plate-no { font: 800 68px/.8 Tektur, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: 75%; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-plate-id { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-end; font: 400 11px/14px 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #9BB5BC); } .ds-datum { height: 2px; background: var(--signal, #FF4A1C); box-shadow: 0 0 10px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--signal, #FF4A1C) 62%, transparent), 0 0 28px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--signal, #FF4A1C) 13%, transparent); }

components.name: Choice
components.description: Quiz answer: full-width row with a Tektur key letter in its end cell; correct in ink, wrong pick in signal.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 360px; min-height: 52px; padding: 4.5px 24px 4.5px 4.5px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink-2, #9BB5BC); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #EAF1F2); font: 400 16px/1.4 Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 12px), calc(100% - 12px) 100%, 0 100%); transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-key { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 40px; height: 40px; background: var(--mist, #131F23); font: 700 24px/.9 Tektur, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-stretch: 75%; } .ds-choice:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #EAF1F2); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal, #FF4A1C); outline-offset: -5px; }

narrative.overview:
Every view is a plate from a survey: a sheet laid on a lit carbon ground, numbered PL.NN, with one datum line drawn through it and one ember signal on it. The subject of the plate is the day's work: the next step on the overview, the step card in the day view, the question in the quiz. Everything else is plate furniture (codes, barcodes, hairlines, facts tables, lamps) set quietly around it.

The system is the owner's Datum design system, version 6, vendored unchanged in `site/dm/` (`bundle.css`, `datum.js`, `tokens.json`, and `tokens.css` written from the tokens). It runs in Datum's default Night palette, carbon and ember, the pair nearest the owner's black and orange reference. The app adds layout and the data it has to show; it does not restyle Datum. Density is that of a working instrument: one step per screen, nothing folded, only the page scrolls, and celebrations on a rising ladder that redraws Datum's own light, arcs, contours, cells and lamps.

The build refuses the generic dark dashboard of equal cards: the overview below the hero is a mosaic of cells on hairlines, not a grid of floating cards. Dark only.
keyCharacteristics: Datum 6, unchanged, Night palette: carbon ground, ember signal.
One datum line per view, one signal fill per view.
Light, not shadow: a lit ground with grain, a key light on the subject, glowing lamps.
Square corners with one 45-degree cut on what you press and what floats.
Onest for words, Tektur for plate figures, Martian Mono for data only.
A real photo in the hero bay, graded to monochrome by Datum and relit in ember.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: A view carries at most one solid signal fill: the `dm-btn--signal` (Start / Continue on the overview, Mark complete or Next in the day view, the go button in each quiz screen) or one signal field (`dm-field-signal`), never both. Every other use of ember is light: lines, lamps, glows, outlines, small `signal-text`.

rules.name: The Tokens Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour in the app's CSS is a Datum token or a `color-mix` of tokens. No hex values appear in `style.css` or `fx.css`; the canvas celebrations read their colours from Datum's tokens.

rules.name: The Dark Only Rule
rules.body: The page is pinned to `data-theme="night"`. Datum's Day theme ships in the vendored files and is not used.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono is for values, ids, measurements and plate furniture, never as a look for prose or headings.

rules.name: The One Title Voice Rule
rules.body: A view takes display or display-light, never both. The hero uses display-light.

rules.name: The One Datum Line Rule
rules.body: Each view has one datum line: under the hero with the summit on it, under the plate header in the day view and the quiz. Content arrives and settles on it in order (`dm-arrive`, `data-i`).

rules.name: The Light Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. A thing stands out because it is lit, rimmed or glowing in signal.

dos: Do use Datum 6 exactly as vendored in `site/dm/`; re-vendor from the artifact when it changes.
Do keep one solid signal fill per view, and let every other ember be light: the datum line, lamps, glows, outlines.
Do build new views from Datum's views and components (Hero, App view, nav block, strip, mosaic, plate header, spec table, notices, choices, train, bar), using Datum 6 tokens only.
Do set every colour as a token; read tokens in canvas code too.
Do keep square corners with one 45-degree cut sized by role (7 / 12 / 16 / 32px).
Do give everything that can be finished a rung on the celebration ladder, and keep every existing rung.
Do make every view work by touch and at phone width: tap paths for hover features, 44px coarse targets, 16px fields.
donts: Don't edit any file in `site/dm/` or override Datum's component styling.
Don't use Datum's Day theme or any light mode; the app is dark only.
Don't put a second signal button or signal field in a view.
Don't use emoji in the UI.
Don't round corners or cast offset drop shadows; depth is light, rim and glow.
Don't set prose or headings in Martian Mono.
Don't set display and display-light in the same view.
Don't add new rules on the Datum 4 alias names; they are a transitional layer, not the system.
Don't trim, merge or quiet a celebration rung.
